open_questions: 0x0805a95e cm_trace_vertical_capsule reads an uninitialised stack word (Ghidra local_14) on the inside path; the binary's value is unknown, translated with 0.0 (partial).

The x87 longdouble intermediates in the decompiled code are reproduced with float/double arithmetic; bit-exact parity needs an objdump-level rounding check on the long chains (notably 0x08056490 and 0x0805a768).
0x080585fe passes model_buf+7 to cm_static_model_init and copies unbounded tokens with strcpy into 64-byte buffers; the preserved overflow behaviour must be reviewed before any hardening.
Ghidra shows 0x080575c0, 0x08058170 and 0x08058c30 as void; the binary returns the tail-call result, so they are typed with a return value. Confirm against callers in other chunks.
LAB_08058148 and LAB_0805815c (callbacks passed to the model registry) are not in this chunk's function list; referenced as fn_08058148 and fn_0805815c. Their owning chunk should provide them.

Model field +0x40 is read as float in cm_brush_trace_planes but is the leaf node index (int) in cm_point_contents; this aliasing is unresolved. The hit surface pointer (0x18) may be stored via an int-to-float conversion in the binary; unverified.

Out-of-chunk callee semantics (fn_0805d552, fn_0805621a, fn_080a6922, fn_080a71b6/738c, fn_080c59da, fn_080c75f6, fn_080c7ab8) are inferred from call sites only; their prototypes in chunk_004_types.h need the owning chunks to confirm.
